external_entities.name: insurance partner
external_entities.description: Three insurance partners that provide daily claim-record extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Three insurance partners drop a daily extract for us.

external_entities.name: analysts
external_entities.description: Analysts who query the warehouse directly from the warehouse network.

processes.name: Airflow scheduler
processes.description: A scheduler that runs at 02:00, lists and reads the landing bucket, and triggers a Spark transform job for each file.
processes.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network wakes up at 02:00, lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there.
processes.notes: It does not check that a file came from the partner whose folder it landed in.

processes.name: Spark transform job
processes.description: A Spark job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery.
processes.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job in the warehouse network.
processes.notes: Nothing validates the row contents beyond the schema.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket where insurance partners place daily claim-record extracts.
data_stores.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know how the landing bucket is encrypted" and that it is on defaults as far as the speaker knows.

data_stores.name: Airflow metadata database
data_stores.description: The metadata database where Airflow keeps its connection strings and partner keys.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.
data_stores.notes: The source says: "I don't know ... whether the Airflow metadata database is encrypted at rest" and that it is on defaults as far as the speaker knows. Its network placement is not stated.

data_stores.name: BigQuery
data_stores.description: The warehouse where the Spark transform loads normalized claim records and analysts query the data directly.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_stores.notes: The dataset-wide grant has not been split to exclude member-identifying columns.

data_flows.name: push files
data_flows.description: Insurance partners push daily claim-record extract files into the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: They push files into a landing bucket over SFTP.
data_flows.data_description: Claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: read files
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler lists the landing bucket and reads the files present there.
data_flows.source_excerpt: lists the bucket, and reads whatever is there

data_flows.name: trigger transform
data_flows.description: The Airflow scheduler triggers a Spark transform job for each file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: For each file the scheduler triggers a Spark transform job

data_flows.name: load records
data_flows.description: The Spark transform job loads normalized records into BigQuery.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The transform normalizes the records and loads them into BigQuery.
data_flows.data_description: Normalized claim records with member names and dates of birth.

data_flows.name: query warehouse
data_flows.description: Analysts query the BigQuery warehouse directly.
data_flows.notes: The analysts authenticate with SSO and have a dataset-wide grant; member-identifying columns have not been split out.
data_flows.data_description: Warehouse claim records, including member-identifying columns.

data_flows.name: store credentials
data_flows.description: Airflow stores its connection strings and partner keys in its metadata database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Airflow keeps its connection strings and the partner keys in its own metadata database.

trust_boundaries.name: landing network
trust_boundaries.description: The network where the Airflow scheduler runs and the landing bucket is located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: An Airflow scheduler running in the landing network

trust_boundaries.name: warehouse network
trust_boundaries.description: The network where the Spark transform job runs and where analysts query the warehouse.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: a Spark transform job in the warehouse network
trust_boundaries.notes: Analysts are also stated to be on the warehouse network.

assumptions.assumption: The Airflow scheduler presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a scheduler that wakes at a scheduled time, lists a bucket, reads files, and triggers a job rather than as a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The Spark transform job presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: It is described as a Spark transform job that normalizes records and loads them into BigQuery rather than as a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The claim records in the landing bucket are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The extracts contain member names and dates of birth, which are personal data whose disclosure can harm individuals.

assumptions.assumption: The connection strings and partner keys in the Airflow metadata database are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The store contains connection strings and partner keys, which are credentials and secrets.

assumptions.assumption: The normalized claim records in BigQuery are confidential.
assumptions.basis: BigQuery contains claim records with member names and dates of birth, which are personal data whose disclosure can harm individuals.
